task.description:
Produce a test specification at tests/specs/DSL-02.md for DSL-02 (AST stability).

DSL-02: The parser MUST produce an AST whose shape is deterministic for a given input. Two parses of the same input MUST yield structurally identical ASTs.
Acceptance Criteria: An equality check over the AST after parsing the same input twice confirms structural identity.

The nodeEql function is already implemented in src/expr/ast.zig.

Test spec must include:
1. Test suite name and requirement traceability (DSL-02).
2. Positive test cases (same input → nodeEql returns true) covering:
   - Integer literal (e.g. "42")
   - Float literal (e.g. "3.14")
   - String literal (e.g. '"hello"')
   - Boolean literal (e.g. "true")
   - null literal
   - Arithmetic expression (e.g. "1 + 2 * 3")
   - Boolean expression (e.g. "x > 0 and y < 10")
   - Dot path (e.g. "order.total")
   - Function call (e.g. "length(name)")
3. Negative test cases (different inputs → nodeEql returns false) covering:
   - Same operator, different operands
   - Same literal type, different value
   - Different node types (e.g. int vs float)
4. No mock or stub — tests run against real parser (src/expr/parser.zig).

Write the spec to tests/specs/DSL-02.md.
Update handoff 20260527-029 and registry entry 20260527-029 with COMPLETED status.
